prompt: Create a refined landscape 3:2 conceptual illustration for an independent science magazine about an experiment in breadmaking with sunflower seed flour. A sliced rustic loaf and a small dish of sunflower kernels on a clean warm neutral linen surface, gentle indirect daylight, restrained earth and cream colors, sophisticated editorial still-life composition, no people, no packaging, no brand, no labels, no text. Elegant and natural rather than advertising, plenty of visual detail and clear composition.
evidence_boundary: Illustrative scene, not a photograph of the experimental breads or evidence of nutrition or health benefits.
